programs.title: Presidents At War
programs.desc: (M) Follows the 8 future American Presidents who actively served during WW2, from 1943 through to the war's end. Learn of their experiences and how these shaped them as leaders.

programs.title: Man Vs. History
programs.desc: (PG) Bil Lepp explores battlefield myths. He investigates why we remember the Alamo, how Davy Crockett really died, and if an "angel's glow" healed Civil War soldiers.
